name: fdhex
comment: Freedraw on the HEXAGONAL grid {6,3}. Three hexagons meet at a vertex, so the abstract configurations are the four binary necklaces of length three. The vertex set is a honeycomb and not a lattice, which the SEARCH does not care about at all; check_marked_grid reads the answer on the dual instead. Reproduces public/freedraw/hex-solutions-k{1,2,3}.json — 5 / 16 / 80 — set for set. Angles in D=24 units: 120 = 8.
